body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and move the target 1 unit. Independently, leave a visible mundane snare in your vacated space if you move during this Action.

surges.html: Deal +1 Damage if the target is already Slowed or Prone.

rider.title: Contingency - Trap
rider.html: When an enemy voluntarily enters your vacated space, it becomes Slowed 2 and Exposed until your next turn; remove the snare.
